name: m2_CollectNear1C590
notes: Collect the scene objects inside a 40-unit box centred on the object position (corners pos-20 and pos+20, w=1) that match the given key; returns the collector result.

name: m2_ChanOffer5EA60
notes: Offer sound channel idx a new pair of sources: each half is taken only when its source is set and the offer priority is at least the current one (the second half also takes the value). Returns 0 if anything was taken, else -1. Stride 0x1C multiply built by cl with lea/sub (stride waiver).

name: m2_PktTag134E0
notes: Flip to the other packet buffer, open it, add GIF tag 1, write header 0x154 with fields 1 and the last two of 0x18 words cleared, reserve 0x18 words and close it; returns the packet cursor. Two names for the same debug stub keep both branch calls.

name: m2_PktTag13590
notes: Flip to the other packet buffer, open it, add GIF tag 2, write header 0x156 with fields 1 and the last two of 0x10 words cleared, reserve 0x10 words and close it; returns the packet cursor. Two names for the same debug stub keep both branch calls.

name: m2_PktTag13640
notes: Flip to the other packet buffer, open it, add GIF tag 4, write header 0x4B with fields 1 and the last two of 0x10 words cleared, reserve 0x10 words and close it; returns the packet cursor. Two names for the same debug stub keep both branch calls.

name: m2_PktTag136F0
notes: Flip to the other packet buffer, open it, add GIF tag 5, write header 0x4D with fields 1 and the last two of 0x1C words cleared, reserve 0x1C words and close it; returns the packet cursor. Two names for the same debug stub keep both branch calls.

name: m2_PktTag137A0
notes: Flip to the other packet buffer, open it, add GIF tag 6, write header 0x4A with fields 1 and the last two of 4 words cleared, reserve 4 words and close it; returns the packet cursor. Two names for the same debug stub keep both branch calls.

name: m2_PktTag13850
notes: Flip to the other packet buffer, open it, add GIF tag 7, reserve 4 words (no header) and close it; returns the packet cursor. Two names for the same debug stub keep both branch calls.

name: m2_SlotAdd376D0
notes: Append a copy of a slot to the 10-entry list (-1 when full); kind-1 slots get field 0x2C doubled in world 4 area 2 and world 1 area 3. The copy last four fields are cleared and the next entry kind reset; returns the new index.

name: m2_RunRecs3F5A0
notes: Run records startC up to min(end, startC+count) through the step function 0x3E6D0, carrying the state and the pen x/y; at the marked record remember x+0x20 and y. Writes the final pen out when asked and returns the state.

name: m2_ObjStep92EA0
notes: Step one of three timed objects: state 0 counts the timer down then goes to state 10 (state 1 for object 0x73 in area 1); state 1 waits until the object flag 0x2C5..0x2C8 is clear then goes to state 10; state 10 releases it and sets flag 0x80.

name: m2_GrpPhase342C0
notes: When the group is idle (header bit 0 and busy word clear), give each flagged (0x20000) entry target a start phase once: num/div when num is 0 and div non-zero (always 0; cl folds the divide the original keeps), else 1, and mark it done. Always returns 0.

name: m2_NodeShow1D610
notes: Clear the head node 0x10000 bit, then walk the sibling list: nodes without the bit unhide their two parts (clear part flag 0x10, unhide its tree), nodes with it hide them; a first part already in the wanted state skips the node.

name: m2_HeapFree47640
notes: Free a heap block (header 0x40 bytes before the pointer) under the heap lock: mark it free, move it to the free list, merge the free blocks after it and then the free block before it, update its usable size (size-0x44) and the heap last block, then release the lock (retrying while release fails).

name: m2_HitTree80E20
notes: Walk node idx with its children (recursive) and siblings (loop); each node with a box gets its hit record reset (centre = middle of the two box corners, radius = half diagonal + 0.01) and appended to the hit list.

name: m2_NodeBox83B70
notes: Compute the bounding box of a node: start from an empty box (+-8388000), grow it over the node parts (0x83A30 with an identity matrix), give every axis at least 0.01 of size, and copy the two corners out.

name: m2_NodeBoxGrow83A30
notes: Grow the bounding box over node idx: chain its local matrix onto the parent one, transform its box corners and widen the box min/max, then recurse into its child (with this matrix) and its sibling (with the parent one).

name: m2_Prompt79480
notes: Pick the active prompt by the sign of 0x3E83E4; when there is one and 0x1A8A90 allows it, start the prompt sound once, load message 1..3 (by video mode table) into the prompt animation and draw it (returns the draw result); otherwise stop the sound once and return the argument unchanged. Three names for 0x529F0 keep the three case calls apart.

name: m2_BvhWalk81D50
notes: Walk the bounding-sphere tree: a node whose sphere (centre moved into view space) is in front of the near plane, before the far distance and inside both view-cone sides draws its leaf (0x81B90) and descends into its children; siblings are always walked.

name: m2_LeafDraw81B90
notes: For each leaf in the list whose object is not flagged 0x12 and whose sphere is inside the view (near, far, both cone sides, object far distance): reset its draw record, set its depth (forced max/min by flags 4/8, else view z), pick the near model within 50 units when it has one, and queue it (0x82720).

name: m2_ActStep93C50
notes: Event actor step. State 0: actor 0x50 or 0xFB in world 2 area 4, once flag 0xBA is set and slot 0x1D accepts it, clears flags 0x810, takes 9999 power, makes its position the home and body position and advances. State 1: releases its sub-object and itself and hides it.

name: m2_CmdRect7A4F0
notes: Script command: read four floats (a rectangle) and an integer from the argument text and add a kind-2 slot with that rectangle in whole units, the integer and a zero vector; stops quietly when a token is missing.

name: m2_PlayAnim7E9B0
notes: Play an animation on every animated node of a model (until a node without bit 0): a node whose animation lacks the clip gets pose flag 2 and ends the walk; otherwise the flag is cleared, the node shown and, unless already playing that id, its clip and speed are set. -1 when the model, a node animation or the clip data is missing.

name: m2_TrackVolume47C80
notes: Re-apply the master volume (0..128 scale) to the playing track: modes 0-1 set the voice volume, mode 2 goes to the debug stub, modes 3..49 and 50+ (bank offset 0x1E3) set every part volume from its base level.

name: m2_ListBoxDraw3F650
notes: Draw a text list box: its title at the remembered pen (or its own corner), a ^ marker when scrolled down, the visible records (0x3F5A0) and a v marker when more follow; returns the draw state. Marker select: original setcc/dec/and/add idiom vs cl cmov of the two characters (same result).

name: m2_MixLoad52CF0
notes: Load channel values from src (src[1] also kept at +0x10, then one per table entry), then give every active element (bits 0 and 0x20000) with a channel the bit masks 1<<shift from its channel two shift bytes; other elements get zero masks.

name: m2_NodeMask1D4E0
notes: Apply the current clip node mask to the nodes after root: node i with mask bit i set gets bit 0x10000 and its two parts hidden; others lose the bit and, unless root has it, get their parts shown. A first part already in the wanted state skips the node.

name: m2_AnimStart831A0
notes: Start an animation on the context: bind its bones (allocating a 0x130-byte-per-bone buffer when the context has none), attach the optional node, set the clip, loop mask 1 by its flag and the speed, clear pose flag 2 and apply it. The id is remembered even when not found. Two names for 0x1AEA00 keep both bind calls.

name: m2_ObjCreate33410
notes: Create a scene object of kind 0 (node with 8 emitter slots bound to the default table, plus an emitter holder) or kind 1 (identity transforms, unit scale, linked into the bank object list). Returns its header (+0x10), or 0 when the pool is full.

name: m2_SparkStep95350
notes: Proximity effect actor: state 0 sparks joints 5..9 (hangs if a joint is missing) and moves to state 1 once the player is 50 units away or more; state 1 returns to state 0 when the player comes within 50; state 10 releases and hides it.

name: m2_CollAdd80F90
notes: Add a model node to the collision world: widen the world box by the node box, build the node hit list (returns 0 when there is none), and link a new collision record (owner thing, value, far distance 8388000) at the end of the world list; every hit points back to it. Returns the record.

name: m2_AxisRot3B180
notes: Build the rotation matrix about a unit axis for an angle given by its cosine c (s = sin(acos c), t = 1 - c); the translation row is copied from the constant vector at 0x2C45D8.

name: m2_SpawnResidents870B0
notes: Spawn every resident entry whose flag is set and whose kind is allowed; near-flagged entries face the player (yaw from 0x1B27C0), others use their stored yaw. The current entry is published at 0x3ED218 during the spawn, and a positive flag number is also given to the spawned object.

name: m2_PickSpawn84F00
notes: Pick the enemy spawn point to use: among enabled points whose timer has run out, keep those 30..60 units from the player, -50..50 units above and within 45 degrees of the view direction (at most 65 kept); remove and return the nearest one entry, or 0 when there is none.

name: m2_SpawnEnemies85110
notes: Try up to count spawn points, nearest suitable first (0x84F00, then the rest of its list): spawn the enemy of each allowed kind facing the player (near points) or with its stored yaw, remember it with an 8-second timer and set its two parameters. Returns how many were spawned.

name: m2_SparkRing954A0
notes: Spark ring actor: state 0 sparks 9 points around joint 3 (even steps 0..6 pushed 12 units along a direction turned 45 degrees per step, the rest at the joint) and moves to state 1 once the player is 50 units away or more; state 1 returns when the player comes within 50; state 10 releases and hides it.

name: m2_TurnActor93A70
notes: Turning actor. State 0: on flag 0x400 it turns away from the player (flat direction), attaches, starts effect 0x291 and advances; on flag 0x800 it waits 0.35 s, then does the same unless the player is within 15 units (then it only sets flag 0x80); the flag is cleared. State 1 resets the direction, sets flag 0x80, stops the effect and returns to state 0.

name: m2_Thunk1DA90
notes: Tail-call thunk to 0x83520 (argument count assumed).

name: m2_CurveValue7F650
notes: Value of a curve: animated curves (flag 2) are evaluated by the operation of their kind (tail call through the table at 0x2E0354), others return their constant.

name: m2_TrackValue7EF00
notes: Value of a track: 0 when there is no track or it has no keys, otherwise evaluated by its type (tail call through the table at 0x2E0210).

name: m2_ActEvent9F040
notes: Actor event handler: events 1-3 arm flag 0x400, event 15 arms flag 0x800 and resets its timer, events 34-35 arm flag 0x200 (each also clears flag 0x80) and return 1; other events return 0.

name: m2_CloseStep9EEA0
notes: Closing actor step: states 0-1 hide it (state 0 also plays close anim 1) and finish (state 5); states 2-3 play close anim 2 or 4 and wait (state 4); state 4 finishes once its animation is done.

name: m2_Trigger94E00
notes: In world 1 area 5, an actor of kind 0x13, 0x15, 0x17 or 0x96 that is not already triggered starts its sub-object and an effect at its position. Returns -1 for no id or no actor, else 1.

name: m2_DoorSync95010
notes: Toggle the solid bit of active doors: when the item count is above 0, kinds 0x1D/0x52 open (bit cleared) and kinds 0x50/0xFB close (bit set); otherwise the other way round.

name: m2_Classify1BC40
notes: Map a (kind, sub-kind) pair to its class number through nested switches (0 when unknown); kind 3 uses a range test, kind 7 maps any non-zero sub-kind to 10.

name: m2_MenuCmd251B0
notes: Menu state command: 0 backs out of states 3-4 to state 2, 1 enters state 1, 2 enters state 4, 3 enters state 5, 4 returns from state 4 to state 3, 5 stores the value as a float; entering a state resets its step fields and the armed flag.

name: m2_TextLines76180
notes: Count the line breaks (code 5) from the current text position to the page end (code 6 or the terminator). Code 7 skips its argument (and two more bytes after a 5); code 4 and characters past the font skip one byte.

name: m2_TextHasPage76210
notes: Return 1 when a page end (code 6) follows the current text position before the terminator, else 0 (same skipping rules as 0x76180).

name: m2_OpenStep9EF40
notes: Opening actor step: state 0 plays anim 3 and finishes (state 5); state 1 waits for the animation, then plays the follow-up for its clip (0 to 1, 2 to 3, 5 to 6) and finishes; states 2-4 play anims 0, 2 or 5 and go to state 1.

name: m2_RegionOpen538A0
notes: Open a memory region in a pool slot (spins until the slot saved pointer is free): name it REGION: <name> (or -), carve it from the slot heap (slot 10 uses the heap of slot 8; slots 9 and above 10 hang), remember the old heap and make the region the slot heap. Returns the new heap. Security-cookie function.

name: m2_PigLoad1E270
notes: Load a .pig texture and its .txa animation named by the two 8-character fields of the record, under the entry directory; attach them to the entry pig (flag 4) or, without one, to the context owner list. Returns the record size 0x10. Security-cookie function.

name: m2_MlbLoad1DFD0
notes: Load the .mlb motion library named by the record 8-character field under the entry directory: create the entry node and the context animation set, and when the entry has no pig and the library loaded, start its first animation and apply it to the pose. Returns the record size 8. Security-cookie function.

name: m2_HmLoad3AC00
notes: Load the height-map file of world (a, b) and link all its entries (with field 0xC cleared) into the list; -1 when the file is missing, else 0. Security-cookie function.

name: m2_TaskFind8E5E0
notes: Look for a kind-8 task matching (a, b, c) in the list: builds a cleared key with a, b and the packed id c | b<<8 | a<<20 (xor-mask merges) and searches in mode 6. Returns 0 for no list. Security-cookie function.

name: m2_LgtLoad8F000
notes: Load the light resource of a kind-2 task once (flag 2): select its heap, build its .lgt path and look it up; when missing, create an empty one (flag 2 at +0x24). Clears flags 4/8. Returns -1 for other task kinds, else 0. Security-cookie function.

name: m2_DfdLoad8EDC0
notes: Load the .dfd resource of a kind-2 task once (flag 2): select its heap, look it up into the object, take its value into the task holder and mirror whether it is set in flag 2 of +0x24. Clears flags 4/8. Returns -1 for no object or other task kinds, else 0. Security-cookie function.

name: m2_DemoLights899C0
notes: Load the demo light_type.txt table and give every model of the demo the light type its key selects (iterator walk). Security-cookie function.

name: m2_SesSave5C0E0
notes: Save a sound-effect set as a .ses file (SES header, version 3, then 0x450 bytes copied from the source) named after world k (area 0 for world 1) and number n. Returns -1 for no source, else the write result. Second argument unused. Security-cookie function.

name: m2_DemoTable898C0
notes: Load demo table (a, b) (.dtt) and merge it with the demo current table; on success the merged data replaces the demo data (ownership moves out of the temporary). Both temporaries are released. Returns 0 or the first error. Security-cookie function.

name: m2_SecSave5C6D0
notes: Save the sound-effect placement list as a .sec file (SEC header, version 4, count, every 0x470-byte record, the two list values and two zero words) named after world (a, b). Returns -1 when out of memory, else the write result. Security-cookie function.

name: m2_ShadowInit22040
notes: Set up a character shadow: load the shadow cube model and circle texture, build the model in the current heap (shrunk to fit), make a node using it and, for entries without a pig, attach it at scale 1. Always 0. Second argument unused. Security-cookie function.

name: m2_DomeShadowInit22150
notes: Same as 0x22040 with the dome shadow model (allocation tags 0xEAC/0xEAD/0xEB2). Always 0. Security-cookie function.

name: m2_SizedShadowInit21EE0
notes: Set up a character shadow from a size record {kind, scale}: kinds 0-1 use the medium shadow model and kind 2 the large one (kind 0 at half scale); otherwise as 0x22040 (tags 0xE5A/0xE5B/0xE60). Returns the record size 8. Security-cookie function.

name: m2_EdgLoad1E110
notes: Load the .edg edge model named by the record 8-character field: build its node in the current heap (shrunk to fit) and, for entries without a pig, give it bone matrices (0x110 bytes each) bound to the context matrices. Returns the record size 8 (also when the file is missing). Security-cookie function.

name: m2_HudStartup2CC20
notes: HUD start-up step: state 0 resets the sound banks and counters, 2 starts the intro movie for the video mode, 3 waits for loading, 100 allocates the HUD and clears the wipe table, 101 (once ready) loads the HUD sprite banks and layout, builds the four HUD sprites and selects the HUD (state 10000). Returns 1 until finished. Security-cookie function.

name: m2_CmdFilter7A610
notes: Script command: add a screen filter slot from the argument text (texture name, value, two integers, a rectangle of four floats stored whole, an integer and up to four optional colour floats); retries until the 10-entry list (0x376D0) has room. Stops quietly when a required token is missing. Security-cookie function.

name: m2_StmLoad50C80
notes: Step the streamed-data loader for the current stream entry: open host0:stm_data/<name>.stm (entries already busy return 0), get a buffer (the caller one or a new one rounded up to 2 KB), seek, wait, read, wait, close, then mark the entry loaded (2) and make it current. Returns 1 while busy, 0 when done. Security-cookie function.

name: m2_StmLoadRaw50560
notes: Same loader as 0x50C80 for the raw (unrounded) size at +0xC (allocation tag 0xB53); the entry is marked loaded with state 1. Security-cookie function.

name: m2_MotLibLoad83820
notes: Load a motion library: read the list file, then for every entry load <directory of the list><name>.pmt and append an animation record (id, speed, frames, mode, flags, loop) to the set. Returns how many motions loaded (0 when the list is missing). Security-cookie function.

name: m2_MotTextLoad83520
notes: Load a text motion list: for every line (up to 0x100 motions) load <dir><name>.pmt, append an animation record and read its CODE, SPEED, COMP, CMP_MOD, MODE (REPEAT/CLAMP) and AM_OFF bit keys. Returns how many motions loaded (0 when the file is missing). Security-cookie function.

name: m2_QueueStep2A830
notes: Message queue step: state 0 arms a 10-frame wait and, with nothing pending, shifts the queue down one entry (else state 1); state 1 shrinks the last glyph with the wait (scale = wait/10) and at 0 removes it and returns to state 0.

name: m2_SelSave5C1E0
notes: Save the owner sound selection list as a .sel file (SEL header, version 1, count, then one value per entry) named after its area (a, b). Always 0. Security-cookie function.

name: m2_SeLoad5C7D0
notes: Load the sound-effect placement file of world (a, b): reset the list, link every record (binding each slot to its sound data) and, for version 4 or later, copy the trailing pair after the records into the list. Returns -1 when the file is missing, else 0. Security-cookie function.

name: m2_JobSweep583C0
notes: Sweep the 6 job buckets: release every running job semaphore and wait (yielding) while it is held and busy; finished jobs (state 3) free their buffer, reset and go back to the free list. The current bucket and job are published while sweeping.

name: m2_AnimSet832D0
notes: Switch the context to animation id (-1 = current): find it (none: current = -1), start its motion with mode bits {4,8,0x10,0x20}[mode]|2 and its length rounded up to whole seconds, clear mask 2, set or clear mask 4 by its loop flag, set its speed and apply it.

name: m2_CollGather822D0
notes: Gather the collision triangles near a sphere (pos, r): take the hit list (or collect the hits in the sphere box); for every hit whose box overlaps walk its groups, skipping groups the filter rejects (unless the world allows all), and add touching triangles tagged with their group.

name: m2_CollGatherSeg824F0
notes: Same as 0x822D0 for a segment p0..p1: the search box is the segment bounds (+0.01), boxes are tested against the segment (0x807C0) and triangles gathered by 0x845D0.

name: m2_StreamSize4F6B0
notes: Size of stream entry i; the original bounds test (i < 0 && i >= 0x21E) can never be true, so the table is always read.

name: m2_FaceNearest80BD0
notes: Find the face whose centre is nearest to pos; when pos lies on its front side, swap its two edge vectors and flip its normal. Returns the face (0 when the set is empty).

name: m2_SegBox807C0
notes: Return 1 when segment p0..p1 touches box (bhi, blo): the segment bounding box must overlap, then the segment is clipped to the two box planes across its dominant axis and that clipped box must overlap too. A near-zero direction gives 0.

name: m2_SpawnPlaced85DE0
notes: Spawn every placed object whose gate flag (when gated) is set, at its position with yaw -yaw: mode 0 by its own kind, modes 1-2 by kind 4 or 5 (low bit of its kind), using the variant call when it has a variant number. Each slot records it was handled and the spawned object (unknown modes keep the previous object).

name: m2_CurveStep5A510
notes: Advance a curve player: synced curves (flag 2) follow their animation time (wrapping by its length in the play direction) and fire events over the covered range, including the wrapped part; free curves advance one frame and either loop (flag 1, firing from -1) or stop at the end. Always 0.

name: m2_SphereMesh3A6B0
notes: Emit a sphere (ellipsoid radii rx, ry, rz) as two strip sets: 2*nu meridian strips over nv+2 rings, then nv latitude strips over 2*nu+1 points; each vertex fourth word is 0 at a strip start and 0x8000 otherwise. Finishes through 0x3A2A0 (tail call).

name: m2_MoverPose8DE70
notes: Pose a moving model at time t: progress through its [t34, t38] window drives nine curves (position, scale and rotation in degrees); builds the matrix, plays its animation, sets the part time (offset plus elapsed; flag set: direct, else rate plus a +1000 bias) and applies the matrix.

name: m2_CamCut8D910
notes: Evaluate a camera cut at the clock time: each channel is its track value at the elapsed time plus its curve value at the progress through the cut (eye x/y/z, target x/y/z, an unused pair, and a last value); when enabled (flag bit 0) build the look-at matrix from eye to target and place it with the last value. Returns -1 without cut or clock, else 0.

name: m2_SndStart5BC90
notes: Start the sound of an entity (when its gate flag is set and sounds are not blocked): kind 12 uses the effect bank offset (none: give up; unset: bank 4 of kind 0), volume defaults to 280, priority from the override or the record, positioned at the child object when there is one; the voice goes into the first free sound slot.

name: m2_PoseFromBytes38650
notes: Build a pose matrix from four packed bytes of a record (128 = centre): unless flag 1, two give rotations (scaled, flag 8 flips the first, wrapped to -pi..pi with fmod); unless flag 2, two give an offset (record flag 4 picks y, else -z); flag 0x10 swaps which bytes are used. The rotation is applied on top of the base matrix; flag 4 levels the offset frame first.

name: m2_NodeSetup35000
notes: Create the scene node for an entity from a definition: spawn it at the decoded (or given, flag 4) cell, bind it to the entity child model (record flag 1 attaches it directly unless flag 1 is passed; flags 0x40/4 aim it along the bone, else copy the bone matrix), apply the record local transform, emitter settings, draw mode and fade, then run its chain. Returns the node or 0.
